watch.summary: The creator reflects on how fast young gamers grow up and compares it to his own realization of turning 28.

beats.what: Creator remarks on how much older Benjyfishy looks compared to his Fortnite days.
He talks about how aging feels slow as a child until time suddenly flies.
He acts out suddenly waking up at age 28 in shock.
He mentions seeing similar fast growth with Cristiano Ronaldo's son.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'm still a kid, I'm still a kid, I'm still a kid, and then boom, 28!
watch.why: The clip is a relatable, conversational reflection on aging rather than a comedy bit. While his animated delivery of turning 28 is amusing, it serves as casual chat talk rather than a laugh-out-loud moment.
